translations.web: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: Anyone who enters the house during any of the days that it is closed up will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
translations.asv: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
